item_name: Rothco Security Patch for Operators Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Security Patch with a hook back measures 1 7/8” x 3 3/8” in size, making it a perfect fit to attach onto Operators Caps. This public safety accessory is made with a durable polyester material with cotton thread. The black patch allows for the SECURITY in silver to standout and be easily read.
